trap.label: while / when
trap.wrong: When I was walking, I was seeing him.
trap.right: While I was walking, I saw him.
trap.why: O português usa 'enquanto/quando' com o mesmo tempo; em inglês while vai com continuous e when com a interrupção.

mcq.q: I ___ the film when you called.

fix.right: While I was playing, he arrived.

fix.wrong: I was seeing her when I was walking.
fix.right: I saw her when I was walking.

fix.wrong: When we was eating, it rained.
fix.right: When we were eating, it rained.

rewrite.prompt: Una com while: “I was cooking. He read.” → While I was cooking, he ___
rewrite.answer: While I was cooking, he was reading.

rewrite.prompt: Una com when: “He called. I was driving.”
rewrite.answer: He called when I was driving.

rewrite.prompt: Past simple: “While I was run, I fell.” corrija
rewrite.answer: While I was running, I fell.
